Its accuracy is quantified against converged numerical solutions, including an exact solution of the coupled problem with finite-rate kinetics. The approximant reproduces the Saito resistance and the $45^{\circ}$ Warburg phase exactly; its modulus is within 0.6\% of the converged solution for $ωa^2/D\le12$ and 7\% below the Cottrell amplitude at high frequency. The uniform-concentration and uniform-flux boundary conditions both give a diffusion impedance of geometric origin, but differ by up to 11\% in modulus because each couples differently to the spreading diffusion field; a criterion based on the rate constant and the disk radius delineates where each applies. The exact solution shows that this crossover is broad and that the decomposition into a charge-transfer resistance and a diffusion impedance is accurate to about 5\% for $1\le2k^0a/D\le100$. Fitted to a published spectrum of a platinum microdisk, it reproduces the reported diffusion coefficient within 1\%, while the two limiting elements lie 4.8\% below and 4.1\% above it. The element is a practical tool for microdisk impedance analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种圆盘电极扩散阻抗的紧致解析表示（Padé近似），可从时域松弛函数变换得到，并扩展到双物种、不同扩散系数及有限动力学情形。
AI.motivation: 微圆盘电极阻抗分析缺乏实用、准确的扩散阻抗解析工具，尤其是均匀浓度与均匀通量边界条件的区别及其适用范围不清楚。
AI.method: 将计时电流松弛函数变换到频域，针对均匀浓度边界条件构造Padé近似，保留低频Saito有限电阻与高频Cottrell行为；推广到氧化还原两物种贡献、非等扩散系数与有限速率动力学，并与收敛数值解（含精确耦合解）比对。
AI.result: 精确复现Saito电阻与45° Warburg相位；在ωa²/D≤12内模量误差小于0.6%，高频较Cottrell幅值低7%。两种边界条件阻抗相差最大11%，并给出基于速率常数与圆盘半径的判别准则；电荷转移电阻与扩散阻抗分解在1≤2k⁰a/D≤100时精度约5%。拟合铂微盘实测谱，扩散系数误差在1%内。
AI.conclusion: 该Padé元件是微圆盘阻抗分析中准确、实用的解析工具，并澄清了边界条件与动力学交叉的适用范围。

title: Development of a Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Transition State Search in Molecular Systems: A Transferable Model Across Structural and Dimensional Variations
summary: We developed a DRL approach for TS searches combining the deep Q-network and the bidirectional long short-term memory architectures to handle variable-sized molecular systems. We applied our method to 1,3,5-hexatriene (Triene), alanine dipeptide (Ala2), and 1,3,5,7-octatetraene (Tetraene) as target systems with the search space limited to backbone dihedral angles. Our model successfully learned the TS search tasks for all examined systems. More importantly, we demonstrate that our model pre-trained on Triene exhibits distinct transfer-learning capabilities across both backbone modifications (Triene to Ala2) and chain extensions (Triene to Tetraene). Such transferability is highly promising for future applications to molecules in general, as it allows an agent trained on simple systems to accelerate TS searches in larger or more complex ones. We expect that these findings on cross-system transferability represent an important step forward in developing DRL-based approaches for TS searches.

AI.tldr: 该研究将深度Q网络与双向LSTM结合，构建深度强化学习（DRL）方法用于分子过渡态（TS）搜索，并证明了跨体系迁移学习能力。
AI.motivation: 分子过渡态搜索通常计算昂贵，且需要处理可变大小的分子体系；希望用DRL自动学习搜索策略，并借助迁移学习让小体系训练的智能体加速大体系TS搜索。
AI.method: 结合深度Q网络（DQN）与双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）处理可变尺寸分子体系；在Triene、Ala2、Tetraene三个体系上，将搜索空间限制为骨架二面角进行TS搜索训练；并以Triene预训练模型迁移至Ala2（骨架改造）和Tetraene（链延伸）。
AI.result: 模型成功学会了全部三个体系的TS搜索任务；Triene预训练模型在骨架改造（Triene→Ala2）与链延伸（Triene→Tetraene）两类迁移场景下均表现出明显的迁移学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 跨体系迁移性使简单体系上训练的智能体能加速更大或更复杂分子的TS搜索，为DRL用于通用分子TS搜索迈出重要一步。

title: The Diffuse Layer of Thin Cylinders: Beyond the Counterion Condensation Paradigm
summary: For over half a century, the counterion condensation theory has served as the dominant view for highly charged cylinders, prescribing a sharp charge renormalization based on the idealized abstraction of a salt-free line charge. In this work, we resolve this problem for physical open-domain systems across all charge regimes using the method of matched asymptotics applied to the non-linear Poisson--Boltzmann equation with added salt. For subcritical fields, where the dimensionless charge parameter satisfies $ξ< 1$, cylindrical curvature suppresses non-linear coupling, leaving the diffuse atmosphere unmodified. Beyond the critical threshold ($ξ= 1$), where the linear theory breaks down due to a localized Boltzmann explosion, the counterion accumulation smoothly transitions into a local flat-wall near-field geometry. By matching these zones, we construct a unified, parameter-free composite analytical solution capturing the spatial crossover toward the global cylindrical Debye screening tail. In the supercritical regime ($ξ> 1$), this near-field regularization locks the far-field effective charge into distinct, concentration-dependent parallel plateaus. Crucially, within the realistic regime where $ξ\le 5$, these idealized plateaus are not always reached, and the effective charge operates within a smooth, variable transition zone. Throughout all regimes, the ionic atmosphere remains diffuse, proving that the limiting laws of condensation emerge as artifacts of omitting the screening electrolyte.

AI.tldr: 本文用匹配渐近法求解含盐非线性Poisson-Boltzmann方程，系统解决高电荷圆柱的反离子凝聚问题，指出经典凝聚定律是忽略屏蔽电解质的假象。
AI.motivation: 半个世纪以来，反离子凝聚理论以无盐理想线电荷为抽象基础，给出尖锐的电荷重整化预言，但缺乏对实际开放体系（含盐、有限曲率）的物理描述。作者希望在所有电荷区间内澄清这一问题。
AI.method: 对含添加盐的非线性Poisson-Boltzmann方程采用匹配渐近展开：分析圆柱曲率对非线性耦合的抑制；在临界阈值ξ=1以上，将局域"Boltzmann爆炸"处理为近场平板壁几何，并将其与远场圆柱Debye屏蔽尾进行匹配，构造参数无关的复合解析解。
AI.result: 亚临界（ξ<1）时圆柱曲率抑制非线性耦合，扩散层不受修正；超临界（ξ>1）时近场正则化将远场有效电荷锁定为随浓度变化的分立平台；在现实区间ξ≤5内，这些理想平台并不总能达到，有效电荷处于平滑可变的过渡区；所有区间内离子氛围始终保持扩散状态。
AI.conclusion: 经典反离子凝聚的极限定律并非真实物理效应，而是省略屏蔽电解质所致的人为产物；含盐开放体系中电荷行为是连续、可变的，需以复合解析解统一描述。

title: Transformer-inspired architectures make machine-learned electron densities accurate and transferable enough to bypass self-consistency
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables; Extended Data (4 figures, 2 tables) and Supplementary Information included
summary: We introduce machine learning models that accurately predict the electron density, the central variable of density functional theory. They are built on Transformer-inspired architectures, which require little computation per parameter and can therefore be enlarged at low cost. The proposed models, SwinUNETR-V2 and its attention-free counterpart NeXtUNETR, achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on QM9, with normalized mean absolute errors in the density averaging 0.075% and 0.046%, respectively. The predicted densities are accurate enough to bypass the self-consistent iteration: a single Kohn-Sham step reproduces the self-consistent electronic structure. For NeXtUNETR, the median errors are 0.036 meV in the total energy, 0.65 meV/angstrom in the forces and 1.8 meV in the HOMO-LUMO gap. The forces not only recover the self-consistent minima in geometry optimization but also successfully drive ab initio molecular dynamics. Fine-tuned on small datasets, both networks also transfer accurately to systems containing elements absent from QM9 or larger than its molecules.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer架构的机器学习模型（SwinUNETR-V2及无注意力版本NeXtUNETR）精确预测电子密度，在QM9上达SOTA，预测密度足以绕过自洽迭代，并能驱动从头算分子动力学且具备良好的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 电子密度是密度泛函理论的核心变量，传统方法依赖昂贵的自洽迭代（SCF）求解；希望用机器学习高效、高精度地直接预测电子密度。
AI.method: 采用Transformer启发式架构（每参数计算量小、易于低成本扩展），提出SwinUNETR-V2及其无注意力对应版本NeXtUNETR，用于预测电子密度。
AI.result: 在QM9上取得SOTA精度，密度归一化平均绝对误差分别为0.075%（SwinUNETR-V2）和0.046%（NeXtUNETR）；NeXtUNETR中位误差：总能量0.036 meV、力0.65 meV/Å、HOMO-LUMO能隙1.8 meV；单次Kohn-Sham步骤即可复现自洽电子结构。
AI.conclusion: 预测密度可绕过自洽迭代，力场既能恢复几何优化中的自洽极小值又能驱动从头算分子动力学；在小数据集上微调后可准确迁移至含QM9之外元素或更大分子的体系。

title: Resolving Photochemical Reaction Pathways Using Field-Induced Surface Hopping Simulation of fs-EUV-TRPES: The Case of Furan
summary: Recent advances in femtosecond extreme ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy have enabled insight into photochemistry in gases, condensed phases, and at interfaces. Assigning spectral features to reaction pathways requires theoretical predictions connecting nonadiabatic dynamics to measured observables. Here, we present a general approach for resolving photochemical reaction pathways by combining field-induced surface hopping with explicit pulse excitation, RMS-CASPT2, and simulations of time-resolved photoelectron spectra. The pump field prepares the excited-state ensemble under experimental conditions, while the multireference treatment describes excited states, conical intersections, and bond-breaking coordinates. Mapping trajectories onto photoelectron signals, supported by a systematic analysis of photoionization approximations, enables comparison with experiment. We apply this approach to furan excited by a 200 nm, 10 fs pulse. Among trajectories returning to the ground state, approximately 87 % hop near the ring-puckering conical intersection and 13 % near the ring-opening intersection. Subsequent ground-state vibrational energy redistribution nevertheless populates ring-opening structures. Five ground-state products are identified. Simulated spectra reproduce time-dependent electron-binding-energy shifts, characteristic kinks, and bands with predicted photoproduct contributions. Compared with Dyson-norm-based intensities, plane- and Coulomb-wave continuum functions improve the early-time shape of the lowest binding energy signal and show that photoelectron anisotropy is more sensitive to the continuum approximation than the angle-integrated spectrum. More generally, these findings demonstrate how explicit-pulse nonadiabatic dynamics and dynamically correlated multireference electronic structure can resolve competing photochemical reaction pathways through simulated fs-EUV-TRPES.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个将显式脉冲激发、场诱导面跳跃非绝热动力学、RMS-CASPT2电子结构与时间分辨光电子谱模拟相结合的通用框架，用于将光化学反应路径分配到光谱特征，并以呋喃(200 nm, 10 fs)为例验证。
AI.motivation: 飞秒极紫外光电子谱实验已能探测气相、凝聚相及界面光化学，但将谱峰归属到具体反应路径需理论预测把非绝热动力学与可观测量联系起来。
AI.method: 将场诱导面跳跃(FISH)与显式泵浦脉冲激发耦合，用RMS-CASPT2多参考方法描述激发态、锥形交叉与键断裂坐标，并把轨迹映射为时间分辨光电子谱；同时系统比较不同光电离近似（Dyson范数强度 vs 平面波/库仑波连续态）。
AI.result: 呋喃经200 nm/10 fs激发后，回到基态的轨迹中约87%在环褶皱锥形交叉处跳跃、13%在开环交叉处跳跃，但后续基态振动能重分布仍填充开环结构，识别出5种基态产物。模拟谱重现了时变电子结合能移动、特征拐折及含光产物贡献的谱带；相比Dyson范数强度，平面波与库仑波连续态改善最低结合能信号的早期形状，且光电子各向异性对连续态近似比角度积分谱更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 显式脉冲非绝热动力学结合动态相关的多参考电子结构，可通过模拟fs-EUV-TRPES分辨竞争性光化学反应路径。

title: Differentiable Electronic Grand Canonical Learning for Electrochemistry
summary: Electronic grand-canonical density functional theory captures how structure and electronic charge respond to electrode potential and, together with statistical mechanics, how these responses give rise to emergent phenomena. However, its computational cost limits the system sizes and sampling times accessible to first- principles simulations. Here, we introduce a differentiable architecture that represents the grand potential and obtains forces and electronic charge as its derivatives, exactly satisfying the mixed-derivative constraints required for thermodynamic consistency, and implement it within the equivariant MACE framework as GC- MACE. We demonstrate more accurate joint learning across multiple electrochemical interfaces and improved transferability to thicker water films relative to previous models, while enabling constant-potential simulations at substantially larger length and time scales than accessible to ab initio molecular dynamics. With broad training data, the framework offers a route to thermodynamically consistent foundation interatomic potentials for the electronic grand canonical ensemble

AI.tldr: 该文提出GC-MACE，一种基于可微架构的电化学界面机器学习势，将巨势表示为可微函数并以其导数获得力和电子电荷，满足热力学一致性约束，实现大尺度恒电位模拟。
AI.motivation: 电子巨正则密度泛函理论能描述结构与电子电荷对电极电位的响应及由此产生的涌现现象，但第一性原理计算成本高，限制了可模拟的体系尺寸与采样时间。
AI.method: 设计可微架构表示巨势，通过求导精确获得受力和电子电荷，严格满足热力学一致性所需的混合导数约束；将其实现于等变MACE框架中，形成GC-MACE。
AI.result: 在多个电化学界面上实现更准确的联合学习，对更厚水膜的迁移性优于先前模型，并能在远大于从头算分子动力学的长度与时间尺度上进行恒电位模拟。
AI.conclusion: 结合广泛训练数据，该框架为构建热力学一致的电子巨正则系综基础原子间势提供了可行路径。

title: Characterizing Reaction Types through Linear Free-Energy Relationships in Cavities
summary: Polaritonic chemistry holds the promise of controlling chemical reactivity through confined light-matter interactions, yet how reactions respond inside optical cavities remains debated. Here, we take a more zoomed-out view, inspired by electrostatic catalysis. We extend nonempirical linear free-energy relationships to cavity-modified reactions and show that their behavior falls into four distinct reaction types set by simple response-crossing rules. Reactions can follow conventional Bell-Evans-Polanyi (BEP) or counterintuitive Opposite-BEP behavior regardless of cavity tuning, or switch between the two as the cavity frequency is varied. We establish this picture analytically and demonstrate it in the Shin Metiu model and in four molecular reactions treated with ab initio electronic-structure methods. Even at this deliberately coarse-grained level, cavity-modified reactivity already shows qualitatively different and strongly counterintuitive behavior, including reactions that switch character with cavity frequency. Yet this complexity can still be reduced to a simple competition between permanent-dipole and polarizability responses. This reaction-type classification therefore provides a new route to organize and anticipate cavity-modified reactivity.

AI.tldr: 本文从类似静电催化的宏观视角出发，将非经验性线性自由能关系推广到腔修饰反应，提出依据"响应交叉规则"的反应四类型分类框架，并用解析推导、Shin-Metiu模型和四个从头算分子反应予以验证。
AI.motivation: 极化激元化学有望通过受限光-物质相互作用调控反应性，但腔内的反应响应机制仍存争议。作者希望在整体、粗粒化层面建立一个可组织与预测腔修饰反应性的简明图像。
AI.method: 将非经验性线性自由能关系(LFER)推广到光学腔修饰反应，从解析角度推导永久偶极响应与极化率响应之间的竞争，并给出四条响应交叉规则，界定四种反应类型；在Shin-Metiu模型和四个从头算电子结构处理的分子反应中加以验证。
AI.result: 腔修饰反应性可归为四类：始终遵循常规Bell-Evans-Polanyi(BEP)行为、始终呈反向BEP行为，或在调节腔频率时于两者之间切换（两种切换方式）。即使在此粗粒化层面，也已出现定性不同且强烈反直觉的行为，包括反应性质随腔频率转变。
AI.conclusion: 腔修饰反应性的复杂表现可还原为永久偶极响应与极化率响应的简单竞争。该反应类型分类为组织与预判腔修饰反应性提供了新途径。

title: Photon Statistics and Light Squeezing Under Vibrational Strong Coupling from Real-Time Nuclear--Electronic Orbital Theory
summary: Molecular polaritons have attracted great interest in recent years as a promising avenue for developing optical control of chemical processes. A major open question in this field is the role of quantum optical effects in understanding the molecular dynamics observed in cavities. In this work, we use our recently developed mean-field quantum and full-quantum real-time nuclear--electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory methods to simulate photon statistics for a cavity mode strongly coupled to a molecular vibrational transition. Our comparative use of these two methods allows us to isolate the contributions of light--matter entanglement to the photon statistics. We consider three initial conditions of the cavity mode: a coherent state, a squeezed coherent state, and a single photon Fock state. These conditions span Poissonian, super-Poissonian, and sub-Poissonian photon statistics. Our full-quantum dynamics initialized with a coherent state show considerable super-Poissonian fluctuations of the photon statistics and light-squeezing of the cavity photons by the vibrational mode. These dynamics are particularly notable considering the quasi-classical properties of the coherent state. The squeezed coherent and Fock state initial conditions also demonstrate noteworthy fluctuations in the photon statistics. All three initial conditions reveal dynamics in the full-quantum photon statistics that differ considerably from the statistics obtained with the mean-field quantum method. Our results demonstrate the importance of considering quantum optical effects for molecules under strong coupling in certain situations.

AI.tldr: 本文用平均场量子与全量子RT-NEO-TDDFT方法模拟强耦合分子振动模式腔的光子统计，隔离光-物质纠缠贡献，并比较三种初始腔态（相干态、压缩相干态、单光子Fock态），发现全量子动力学出现显著超/亚泊松涨落与光压缩，与平均场结果差异明显。
AI.motivation: 分子极化激元被视为光控化学的有前景途径，但腔中分子动力学里量子光学效应的作用仍是核心未解问题，需明确光-物质纠缠对可观测统计量的贡献。
AI.method: 采用作者新近发展的平均场量子与全量子实时核-电子轨道含时密度泛函理论（RT-NEO-TDDFT）模拟与分子振动跃迁强耦合的腔模光子统计，通过两法对比隔离光-物质纠缠贡献；初始腔态设为相干态、压缩相干态与单光子Fock态三类。
AI.result: 全量子动力学在相干态初始下表现出明显超泊松光子涨落及振动模式对腔光的压缩；压缩相干态与Fock态初始亦显示可观涨落。三种初始条件下全量子光子统计均与平均场量子方法结果显著不同。
AI.conclusion: 在强耦合分子的特定情形下，量子光学效应（光-物质纠缠）对光子统计有重要影响，不可由平均场方法替代，须纳入分子极化激元理论建模。

title: Generalizing Density Functional Theory with a Particle-Hole Expansion
summary: Strong electron correlation remains difficult to describe within conventional density functional approximations, particularly when natural-orbital occupations become strongly fractional. We introduce a systematic particle-hole expansion that generalizes density functional theory (DFT) through an explicit functional of the one-electron reduced density matrix. The previously derived cumulant-based correction emerges as the leading term and the thermal (entropic) correction as an infinite-order member whose coefficients are fixed by a single parameter. The expansion can be formulated as a moment problem solved by semidefinite programming with computational scaling comparable to DFT. We show that both the first- and second-order corrections yield closed-form natural-orbital occupations. Applications to periacenes and Fe-porphyrin demonstrate that the second-order correction substantially reduces excessive orbital fractionalization, yielding natural-orbital occupations and fundamental gaps in improved agreement with correlated calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种系统的粒子-空穴展开，用单电子约化密度矩阵泛函推广DFT，可写成半正定规划的矩问题，计算规模与DFT相当，二阶修正显著缓解轨道过度分数化。
AI.motivation: 传统密度泛函近似难以描述强电子关联，尤其当自然轨道占据数出现强烈分数化时尤为困难，需要超越常规DFT的泛函形式。
AI.method: 构建以单电子约化密度矩阵为显式泛函的粒子-空穴展开；已有的累积量(cumulant)修正作为首阶项，热(熵)修正作为无穷阶项且仅由一个参数确定系数；整体表述为用半正定规划求解的矩问题，计算标度与DFT相当；给出第一、二阶修正的自然轨道占据数闭式解。
AI.result: 在periacenes和Fe-porphyrin上的应用表明，二阶修正大幅减少过度的轨道分数化，所得自然轨道占据数与基本能隙与关联计算的符合程度更好。
AI.conclusion: 该粒子-空穴展开为在DFT框架内系统处理强关联提供了一条可行路径，兼具较低计算成本与对分数化占据的改进描述。

title: Dual Area-Volume-of-Fluid (DAVOF): co-advecting volume and face-area fractions for a closed-form, cell-local interface normal and position on unstructured meshes
comment: 45 pages, 9 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/tmaric/TwoPhaseFlow (branch davof) and https://github.com/leia-openfoam/leia (branch development)
summary: Geometric Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) on unstructured polyhedral meshes reconstructs the interface orientation from the volume fractions of a stencil of neighbours; on irregular cells and in the presence of wisps it degrades, and the curvature built on it drives the parasitic currents of capillary flows. We transport, consistently to the volume fraction of every cell, the wetted fraction of every face area. From the area and volume fractions, closed-form equations recover the interface normal and position of a cell, for the first time in VOF: the normal from one sum over the cell's own faces, the divergence theorem on the liquid sub-volume, and the plane's position from a second, without neighbours or iteration. Both identities are exact for a plane on hexahedral, perturbed and polyhedral cells. On a sphere and an ellipsoid the normal has the order of the face fractions, the position is second order for every state and mesh, and a quadric through one ring of recovered normals gives a converging curvature where the reference models show none. Transported with the plane clipping, the ring normal, the same identity on the union of the cell's ring, stabilises the state and carries a sphere over 3.3 diameters bounded and conservative, first order in the face fractions as the clipping law predicts, at plicRDF's position and shape errors. A preliminary transport implementation with one paraboloid per cell, its frame from the normal, its curvature tensor from the ring and its position from the volume fraction, carries the sphere bounded and conservative over the resolution ladder with face fractions of order 2.8 per period with the exact normal and 2.1 with the ring quadric's normal over N = 32 to 128. The loop has the order of the normal it is fed; a transported normal of second order is the research goal. This document is the basis on which the further development of the method is documented.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在非结构多面体网格上基于面润湿面积分数的几何VOF新方法：无需邻元或迭代，由单个单元自身面上的求和与散度定理闭式恢复界面法向和位置，并给出输运与曲率计算方案。
AI.motivation: 传统非结构多面体网格几何VOF依赖邻元模板的体分数重建界面方向，在畸形单元和存在"wisps"时退化，其曲率驱动毛细流寄生电流，精度与稳定性不足。
AI.method: 与各单元体分数一致地输运每个面面积的润湿分数；由面积分数与体分数通过两组闭式恒等式恢复界面法向（对单元自身面求和）与位置（液体子体积上的散度定理），并用"环"（单元环并集）上的同一恒等式或环法向的二次曲面求曲率；输运采用平面裁剪，另给出每单元一个抛物面（法向定坐标架、环定曲率张量、体分数定位置）的初步实现。
AI.result: 两恒等式对平面在六面体、扰动及多面体单元上均精确；球与椭球上法向为面分数阶、位置对各状态与网格均二阶，过一环法向的二次曲面给出收敛曲率而参考模型无。平面裁剪输运使球跨越3.3个直径保持有界守恒，一阶且位置与形状误差达plicRDF水平；抛物面实现于N=32–128分辨率阶梯有界守恒，每周期面分数阶分别为2.8（精确法向）与2.1（环二次曲面法向）。
AI.conclusion: 闭环精度受输入法向阶数限制，二阶输运法向是后续研究目标；本文档为方法进一步发展提供基础。

title: PhysicsNeMo-Mesh: GPU-Native Meshes and Simulation Cases for Physics AI
summary: PhysicsNeMo-Mesh is the mesh module of the open-source PhysicsNeMo library. It provides mesh processing similar to PyVista, but on the GPU, in batches, and inside PyTorch's automatic differentiation. Like xarray for unstructured meshes, it attaches semantics to data: fields on points, cells, and whole meshes have names and shapes, and a simulation case keeps the complete PDE problem specification, including boundary conditions and their prescribed values. It addresses three problems that plague machine learning for physical simulation. First, GPU utilization is bottlenecked by I/O, because samples are very large relative to the compute per forward pass. Second, because traditional preprocessing is expensive, it is necessarily done once, during curation, rather than differently for each model and workflow at the point of use. Finally, advanced equivariant and mesh-native architectures require information that curation ordinarily discards. Fast GPU mesh processing makes it practical to preprocess at the point of use: on one GB200 GPU, mesh operations run $6.2\text{--}1{,}068\times$ faster than VTK with 72 threads, and loading a whole case is $8.0\text{--}88\times$ faster than reading its VTK files ($8.0\times$ when both read the same fields). Overlapped with training, this preprocessing costs $2.1\%$ of throughput for a $127\,\text{ms}$ Transolver step. So one dataset serves many models and workflows: in PhysicsNeMo's public recipe, one stored DrivAerML dataset feeds Transolver, GeoTransolver, and GLOBE. PhysicsNeMo-Mesh combines the speed of an intermediate array store with the flexibility of an archival format such as VTK. When shapes and wall conditions both vary, per-boundary conditions cut a heat-conduction error from $87\%$ to $6\text{--}9\%$. And by keeping field ranks and named boundaries, it retains the semantic structure that next-generation architectures will need.

AI.tldr: PhysicsNeMo-Mesh 是 PhysicsNeMo 的网格模块，在 GPU 上、批处理、并在 PyTorch 自动微分内实现类 PyVista 的网格处理；通过"即用即处理"使一份数据集服务多种模型与工作流。
AI.motivation: ML 物理仿真受三大问题困扰：(1) GPU 利用率受 I/O 瓶颈限制，样本相对每次前向计算过大；(2) 传统预处理昂贵，只能一次性在数据整理阶段做，无法按模型/工作流需求定制；(3) 等变与网格原生架构需要整理阶段通常被丢弃的信息。
AI.method: 在 GPU 上以批处理方式、嵌入 PyTorch 自动微分进行网格处理；像 xarray 一样为非结构网格数据附加语义——点/单元/整体网格场带名称与形状，仿真案例保留完整 PDE 问题规格（含边界条件及预设值）；保留场秩与命名边界等语义结构。
AI.result: 单张 GB200 上网格操作比 72 线程 VTK 快 6.2–1,068 倍；整案例加载比读 VTK 文件快 8.0–88 倍（读相同场时 8.0 倍）；与训练重叠时，对 127 ms Transolver 步仅损失 2.1% 吞吐。单一 DrivAerML 数据集可同时供 Transolver、GeoTransolver、GLOBE 使用；形状与壁面条件均变化时，逐边界条件将热传导误差从 87% 降至 6–9%。
AI.conclusion: PhysicsNeMo-Mesh 兼具中间数组存储的速度与 VTK 等归档格式的灵活性，支持即用即处理与多模型复用，并为下一代架构保留必要的语义结构。

title: A Gaussian-Process Surrogate for Control Rod Worth with Calibrated Uncertainty: Application to VERA Core Physics Benchmark Problem 4
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to M&C 2027, the International Conference on Mathematics and Computational Methods Applied to Nuclear Science and Engineering (American Nuclear Society), 2 October 2026
summary: Differential and integral control rod worth are usually obtained by differencing eigenvalue calculations at discrete rod positions, which resolves the derivative poorly and gives it no uncertainty. We build a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate for reactivity as a function of rod position on VERA Core Physics Benchmark Problem 4, a $3\times3$ assembly cluster with a hybrid AIC/B$_4$C rod cluster control assembly, modelled in OpenMC with ENDF/B-VIII.0. A parametric sigmoidal mean carries the dynamic range, a Matern-5/2 GP carries the residual, and the reported Monte Carlo uncertainty of each run enters as known observation noise. Because differentiation is linear, the differential rod worth and its variance follow in closed form from the kernel derivatives. Trained on 43 runs at three particle counts and tested on 11 independent runs, the surrogate meets a fixed 10 pcm accuracy target above the test-run noise, and its intervals are calibrated: the standardized leave-one-out residuals over 129 independent runs have variance 1.07 with 95% interval [0.85, 1.39]. The total worth agrees with the direct OpenMC end-point difference within combined uncertainty, and the differential worth peak is located to within one step. Three mean functions of very different fit quality give the same differential worth to within 0.1 pcm/step, while the width of its band depends on the kernel smoothness by a factor of four. The number of runs required and the remaining approximations are reported, and the extension to rod position and soluble boron is outlined.

AI.tldr: 用高斯过程代理在VERA基准题4上拟合反应性随控制棒位置的变化，从核函数导数解析给出微分价值及其方差，并经129次独立计算验证了区间校准（标化LOO残差方差1.07，95%区间[0.85,1.39]）。
AI.motivation: 传统微分/积分控制棒价值靠离散棒位本征值做差分，导数分辨率差且无不确定度。希望获得连续、带可信区间且计算经济的功能曲线。
AI.method: 在OpenMC（ENDF/B-VIII.0）中建模VERA基准题4（3×3组件簇，AIC/B4C混合棒束），用参数Sigmoid均值函数承载动态范围、Matern-5/2核高斯过程拟合残差，将每次MC的统计误差作为已知观测噪声；利用微分是线性算子，微分棒价值及其方差由核函数导数闭式给出。训练43次、测试11次，并做129次独立计算的LOO校准检验。
AI.result: 代理模型在测试运行噪声之上满足固定10 pcm精度目标；LOO残差方差1.07、95%区间[0.85,1.39]，区间校准良好；总价值与直接端点差法在合成不确定度内一致，微分价值峰值定位误差≤1步；三种拟合质量差异很大的均值函数给出的微分价值差异仅0.1 pcm/step，而其置信带宽度随核平滑度变化达约4倍。
AI.conclusion: GP代理可给出带校准不确定度的连续微分/积分控制棒价值，减少所需MC运行次数；均值函数不敏感但核平滑度显著影响区间宽度。文中报告了所需运行数与遗留近似，并展望扩展至棒位与可溶硼的联合建模。

title: Predicting Weight Windows for Duct-Streaming Shielding Geometries with a Convolutional Neural Network
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to M&C 2027, the International Conference on Mathematics and Computational Methods Applied to Nuclear Science and Engineering (American Nuclear Society)
summary: Forward-flux-based weight windows give global variance reduction for duct-streaming shielding problems, but each new geometry needs an iterative Monte Carlo calculation to build them. We report preliminary results on a convolutional neural network (CNN) that learns the map from a two-dimensional duct geometry and source position to the lower window bound of such an iteration, here the MAGIC generator in OpenMC, in milliseconds. A set of 250 random concrete ducts of three curved and rectangular families on the Protvino labyrinth bounding box was run in OpenMC with a Cf-252 point source and MAGIC generation, and a 1.9-million-parameter U-Net was trained on the logarithm of the lower bound. On held-out ducts the error in the cells that carry the flux is 0.14 to 0.51 decades; replicate MAGIC runs show this part of the map to be reproducible to a few hundredths of a decade, so the residual is model error, while below $10^{-6}$ the reference itself is noise. Applied without retraining to the rectangular Protvino labyrinth, the prediction correlates with MAGIC at 0.96. Used as weight windows there, with its deepest cells clamped at deployment, it gives an exit-detector figure of merit 54 times the analog value, 1.7 times that of the MAGIC generation run for the same geometry, and 0.80 of that of reused MAGIC windows whose construction it does not pay for. The run cost of any window set is shown to be set by its deepest cells and predictable from a population proxy.

AI.tldr: 用U-Net从二维管道几何与源位置直接预测OpenMC MAGIC生成的权窗下界，毫秒级替代迭代蒙卡；在Protvino迷宫上FOM为模拟值54倍、优于该几何MAGIC生成、接近复用MAGIC窗口的0.8。
AI.motivation: 前向通量权窗可为管道穿透屏蔽问题提供全局减方差，但每遇新几何都需迭代蒙卡（如MAGIC）重新构造权窗，耗时不可接受。
AI.method: 在Protvino迷宫包围盒内构造250个随机混凝土管道（三类弯曲、矩形族），以Cf-252点源在OpenMC中运行MAGIC生成窗口；训练190万参数U-Net，学习从几何+源位置到权窗下界对数的映射；再以不重训方式应用于矩形Protvino迷宫，并在部署时对最深单元做截断。
AI.result: 留出管道中携通量单元误差0.14–0.51个数量级，而MAGIC复算可复现到百分之几数量级，说明残差为模型误差；低于1e-6处参考本身为噪声。迁移到矩形迷宫时与MAGIC相关系数0.96。作为权窗使用时出口探测器FOM为模拟值的54倍、为同几何MAGIC生成运行的1.7倍、为复用MAGIC窗口的0.80；并表明任意窗口集的运行代价由最深单元决定，可由种群代理量预测。
AI.conclusion: CNN可毫秒级近似MAGIC权窗构造，省去迭代成本，性能可与人工迭代窗口竞争，且窗口运行成本可由最深单元预测。
